stories.raw_headline: WhatsApp Business Platform gets costlier from today: What Indian businesses need to know about new messaging charges
stories.description: Meta has changed WhatsApp Business Platform pricing as of 1 October, making service messages chargeable in India after the monthly free quota. Indian businesses get 1,000 free service messages per phone number each month, after which they will pay ₹0.115 per delivered message.

stories.description: arXiv:2605.29637v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models often exhibit a substantial gap between their performance in English and in lower-resourced languages on equivalent knowledge queries---a cross-lingual consistency issue that remains underexplored for Indian languages and their code-mixed counterparts. To study this gap, we introduce IndicKLAR, an Indic extension of the KLAR-CLC benchmark covering 18 of the 22 scheduled Indian languages.
